# rewrites.bio

> Principles for rewriting bioinformatics tools with AI. Responsibly.

rewrites.bio is a manifesto and set of guiding principles for the responsible AI-assisted rewriting of established bioinformatics tools in faster, compiled languages. It covers 12 principles across 4 sections: Philosophy, Planning, Building, and Stewardship.

For complete documentation in a single file, see [Full Documentation](https://rewrites.bio/llms-full.txt).

## Docs

- [The Manifesto](https://rewrites.bio/manifesto.md): The full set of 12 principles for responsible AI-assisted bioinformatics rewrites
- [Full Documentation](https://rewrites.bio/llms-full.txt): Complete manifesto in one file (same content as manifesto.md)
- [Agent Instructions](https://rewrites.bio/.well-known/agent.md): Discovery metadata and content negotiation for AI agents
- [Agent Skills](https://rewrites.bio/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Machine-readable skill index
- [API Catalog](https://rewrites.bio/.well-known/api-catalog): Content endpoint catalog (RFC 9727)
- [Auth](https://rewrites.bio/auth.md): Public access — no authentication required

## Optional

- [Source repository](https://github.com/seqeralabs/rewrites.bio): Site source on GitHub
- [MCP Server Card](https://rewrites.bio/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Agent tool and resource discovery
